items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: No, I didn't. In fact, I liked it. Yeah, I enjoyed that style.

ctx.x: When Dizzy and Charlie Parker got together and it was supposedly a new kind of jazz came together, did you find that threatening or surprising, like some of the musicians who'd been playing a while did?
No, I didn't. In fact, I liked it. Yeah, I enjoyed that style.
You seem to have always admired guys with good chops.
